title: Lattice network setup slate and modal screens for private deployment onboarding
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Create a distinct set of onboarding visuals and screenshot-ready assets for the Private/VPC product flow that emphasizes a progressive 'lattice' approach to network setup. Deliver a slate of primary screens and complementary modals that guide infra engineers through: preflight checks, subnet mapping, route preview, optional advanced peering, and an in-place upgrade preview. Focus on concise microcopy, conditional hints for common misconfigurations, and exportable assets for docs and release notes.
acceptance_criteria: Complete Figma file with annotated artboards for all primary steps (preflight, mapping, peering, upgrade preview)
Exported PNGs and SVGs for each screen at 2x resolution for release notes and marketing
Componentized modal and stepper tokens added to the Design System (button states, toast, validation states)
Hand-off checklist completed and linked to Engineering PRs and Console feature flags
Usability sanity test with 5 platform engineers with documented feedback and >80% success on core tasks
notes: Design should assume both light and dark console themes; provide color token mapping for each
Keep primary CTA copy consistent with Console patterns: 'Run preflight', 'Apply mapping', 'Schedule upgrade'
Preflight step needs a collapsible 'what we check' panel so users can inspect checks without leaving the flow
Include retry and error states for intermittent network failures (screenshots for 502/timeout)
